title: Agentic RAG: smarter, or just busier?

source.name: Towards Data Science
source.title: Does Agentic RAG Actually Retrieve Better Evidence? I Tested It on 298 Questions

description: Does an agent loop actually improve retrieval? A quick look at what to measure before you add one.

scenes.narration: Everyone says agentic RAG retrieves better evidence. But does it?
scenes.headline: Smarter, or just busier?

scenes.narration: A Towards Data Science writer tested it on two hundred ninety eight questions, because the demo always looks smart.
scenes.headline: The pitch vs the bill

visual.bottom_text: Agentic RAG: five retrievals and a plan

scenes.narration: Before you add an agent loop, check three things. Does recall go up? Does latency stay sane? Is the cost worth it?
scenes.headline: Before adding the loop

scenes.narration: The classic trap: if you never measure retrieval on its own, you never see the bad evidence.
scenes.headline: Measure retrieval first

scenes.narration: My take: evaluate retrieval separately from answer quality. Do you? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.headline: Do you evaluate retrieval separately?
